title: M5GFX PR #422 board_detect log-warning fix fails to compile with ESP_LOGD enabled

hardware.reason: Compile-time/preprocessor defect with no runtime observable; no M5GFX firmware involved.

execution.virtual_device: NOT RUN: no Arduino/ESP-IDF toolchain to build a minimal M5GFX sketch for any emulator profile; defect is decided at compile time

checks.name: read PR body, comments and reviews
checks.details: No comments or reviews before this review; body claims no behaviour change and quotes the two CORE_DEBUG_LEVEL=0 warnings.

checks.name: base warning reproduction with log arguments compiled out
checks.details: 6 -Wall -Wextra warnings, including transaction.inl:59 missing_pin and detector_runner.inl:51 family.

checks.name: PR removes the two reported warnings at log level 0
checks.details: Remaining 4 warnings are -Wunused-parameter in ops.inl:19/20 and prepare.inl:8, out of the PR's stated two-warning scope.

checks.name: PR compiles with ESP_LOGD enabled
checks.details: detector_runner.inl:66:80: error: use of undeclared identifier 'family'; base compiles cleanly.

checks.name: repository host test suite on base 28d4794
checks.details: sh test/board_detect/run.sh -> C++ test programs: 33 passed.

checks.name: repository host test suite on PR head ab6cf1c
checks.details: Aborts on the first translation unit (airq_generated.cpp) at detector_runner.inl:66 due to the same undeclared identifier.

checks.name: transaction.inl rewrite equivalence on 7 runtime scenarios
checks.details: Identical captured log output for pins {5}, {0}, {7}, {-1,...}, including the pin=0 sentinel boundary; pin<0 is skipped before the sentinel is assigned.

checks.name: full Arduino/ESP-IDF build at CORE_DEBUG_LEVEL=4/5
checks.details: No toolchain installed; host compile matrix and the repository host suite used instead.

checks.name: upstream reply
checks.details: Posted one English comment at https://github.com/m5stack/M5GFX/pull/422#issuecomment-6911547651; PR left open, no code pushed.

notes: Read-only review: no M5GFX change, no push to the author's branch, no PR close.
The host stub implements the documented M5GFX_BOARD_DETECT_IO_HEADER contract; only the ESP_LOGx argument evaluation differs between the two builds.
Host-level result, not a virtual-device or hardware result.
All workflows for head ab6cf1c were action_required (first-time contributor approval) at review time, so CI had not run the failing BoardDetect job yet.
